run_dora_grid: run a dora grid command to schedule and monitor SLURM experiment jobs on a cluster
run_dora_launch: launch a dora job on a remote SLURM partition with GPU allocation and optional log tailing
run_dora_run: run a dora training job locally with optional distributed data parallel workers
run_dora_info: check dora job info by signature or job ID including logs metrics and cancel options
run_dora_export: export dora experiment signatures to share or back up completed XP runs
